title: Любовь принцессы Мэгохимэ
description: Web shorts to promote the city of Miharu, Fukushima. Instead of developing a strictly historical story, the anime looks into the near future where a virtual game called "IXA" exists. Within "IXA" are artificial intelligence versions of Megohime and historical warlords. (Source: Anime News Network)

en:
Web shorts to promote the city of Miharu, Fukushima.

Instead of developing a strictly historical story, the anime looks into the near future where a virtual game called "IXA" exists. Within "IXA" are artificial intelligence versions of Megohime and historical warlords.

(Source: Anime News Network)
